messages:
Maria Nunez: Quick sync 7: marketplace asked for SOC2 summary, pen-test report, and an S3 artifact bundle (presigned upload). Need owners for presign flow, redaction, and TTL. Submit by next Wed.
Devon Park: I can own presign and S3 path. Need exact artifact list + manifest.
Samir Shah: Does pen-test need infra vendor scope (SI/hardware partners) or just our app+connectors? Scope affects timeline.
Elaine Kim: Marketplace usually wants redacted full reports + attestation of fixes. I can handle redaction once security gives PII rules.
Devon Park: Draft presign command: `aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/redwood/{partner}/{listing}/bundle.zip --expires-in 604800` TTL=7d. We'll emit temp creds and metadata tags.
Samir Shah: I'll check with Security on pen-scope by EOD. If vendor reports are required, we need to request them from partners.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: upload window opens in 5 business days. See https://marketplace.portal/uploads for limits.
Maria Nunez: KMS key origin requested by partner. For Private we can provide HSM attestation; for hosted we'll provide KMS key id + rotation policy. Who can draft key attestation text?
Elaine Kim: I'll draft key attestation + redaction checklist. Please share SOC2 summary doc (control mapping & date).
Devon Park: Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace-presign. Manifest example: `{ "listing_id": "acme-connector", "artifacts": ["soc2-summary.pdf","pen-test-summary.pdf","attestation.txt"], "contact": "security@redwood.ai" }`
Samir Shah: Action: I'll confirm pen-scope and loop vendor if needed.
Maria Nunez: Action owners: Elaine = redaction & key attestation; Devon = presign & manifest; Samir = pen-scope. Will consolidate and upload Thu morning for partner review Thu afternoon. React with :thumbsup: when you have docs or blockers.
Elaine Kim: Got it 1 will share checklist by EOD.
Devon Park: Will post mock manifest + presign link when ready.
Samir Shah: Sync complete with Security; vendor pen-test requested (if applicable).
Maria Nunez: Thanks all  ping me if anything slips.
